selector.scope: Actual fixed-dimension selector and original argmax, all three sampler memories and numerical logic retained. Safety of configuration/seed/PRNG commitment, accepted-start winner ownership, stalls, CLEAR/fault/reset. Not a numerical CDF-equivalence, per-row memory-initialization or whole-machine theorem.

selector-buffer.scope: Actual full selector, all 4019-row logits/mass RAM entries and every exponential ROM word retained. A read-only child row-count output and unconstrained constant slot observe complete accepted-head ownership, per-slot writes before healthy sampling reads, captured memory payload, and mass-pass ownership. No production feedback, parameters, assumptions or input cuts. Not mathematical CDF equivalence, whole-machine, physical-memory clearing or four-state simulation theorem.

shell.scope: Actual seeded token shell with original embedding/normalizer/arithmetic children and complete fixed-dimension sampler, actual RAMs retained. Original 48 controller/tape assertions plus settings-boundary and sampler lifecycle assertions jointly proved. One unconstrained constant tape-slot observer never drives production logic. External private model/layer/head service ports remain arbitrary; not numerical fixed-model, whole-private-memory, core/UART composition or mapped-implementation refinement.

uart.scope: Actual CPB217 RX/TX, extended bridge and unchanged operation adapter; actual frontend instances extracted from frozen uart_core. Independent admitted-byte history, complete SETTINGS/legacy provenance, timeout ownership, atomic settings payload, operation authorization and reply framing. Backend readiness/model outputs/settings feedback are unrestricted component input ports. No backend, whole-machine, TX-waveform or UART-authentication theorem.

changed_cache_stage_proof.cancellation_knownness_scope: Cancellation may revoke logical knownness while captured payload/assembly coherence remains. Fault replies are masked. These source properties do not establish physical memory erasure.
limits: No whole-machine or full cache-equivalence theorem.
No trusted external DDR content or cryptographic K/V integrity assumption or claim.
No eventual-response/fairness or fatal-reset-free liveness claim.
No unconditional local accepted-write ownership/drain theorem across terminal failure. No unexpected completion input is assumed away.
No independently latched historical-DDR semantic row content theorem; physical fill mux fidelity is separate from accepted pending-stage provenance.
No physical RAM initialization/erasure, mapped/native/timing/route/board qualification.
No inherited141 assertion total or pass flag.

Cancellation revokes logical stage knownness only. Selected-point and captured/stage/assembled payload coherence remain required through CLEAR and terminal failure; retained payload erasure is not claimed.
Synchronous two-state source safety only; no electrical CDC, physical implementation, native timing or board qualification is inferred.
Only the primary Z3 campaign is credited. No independent second-solver completion or proof credit is claimed.
The recorded audit reconstructs consumed evidence and repeats the RAM/observer audit without rerunning the solver or elaborator; independent tool-execution attestation is excluded.
changed_cache_stage_proof.scope: Recorded full source reset-base plus joint-prior inductive safety with exact consumed-query/log reconstruction and actual RAM/observer audit. Independent tool-execution attestation, full cache equivalence, terminal-local write drain and mapped/physical claims are excluded.
changed_cache_stage_proof.terminal_scope: Healthy and CLEAR ownership/drain safety; terminal fail-stop may abandon local accepted writes until reset. No unexpected-input assumptions or unconditional terminal-local-drain claim.

limits: Source-only relative ROM safety/equivalence; no full attention FSM, whole model, vendor primitive, mapped image, physical or security theorem.
FILE parser/I/O uses standard RTL readmemh semantics. Arbitrary32-bit image dataflow is proved; partial/addressed/XZ FILEs are finite actual simulation fixtures.
Coupled unspecified initial selected payload/metadata is an explicit representation premise, not an assumption that valid response data already matches.
Clock-level source induction uses async2sync; analog reset pulse widths, glitches and metastability are not claimed.
No native inference/resource/routing/timing result or FPGA model/flash/write action is credited here. Root-owned synthesis previews and any future mapped-ROM audit remain separate.
These query/transcript counts are nonadditive with all existing stochastic, transport, arithmetic and whole-model evidence; no aggregate machine assertion total is claimed.

scope.composition: Initializer image correspondence and source-proved immutable storage plus runtime state induction preserve all four observable outputs along unbounded clock-sampled digital input sequences. Reset assertion outputs and actual asynchronous pulse behavior are separately checked.
scope.file_image: Actual source-parsed1024loop and four disjoint copies prove each low word0..4095 and independent endpoint4096 come from the same complete FILE image; addresses/counts are checked nonwrapping. Source-runtime theorem assumes the resulting requested-word image relation, discharged by that copy construction.
scope.four_state: Nine actual original/candidate FILE simulations, all8192 addresses each, pre-read/unreset X,32X/Z control cases and one between-clock asynchronous reset pulse perFILE. Six complete known-integer files also get198144 independent public transaction-oracle comparisons. This is finite four-state evidence, not a universal four-state SMT theorem.
scope.independent_scalar: Unmodified full e47 reference, namespace-only in simulations; no candidate ROM is shared with the reference.
scope.initial_state: Explicit representation coupling of unspecified initial selected payload and metadata/sticky state; constructive low-selected witness covers every initial32-bit payload. Unrelated power-up states are not compared.
scope.runtime: Complete actual-source four-output and inductive state-correspondence proof for arbitrary13-bit request/index sequences and arbitrary32-bit immutable FILE words. No valid-encoding assumption or runtime/output cuts.

unproved_private_sha_boundary.scope: Unproved private compression boundary; finite arithmetic/transactions and full-model executions only. No SHA arithmetic/security/private-bank refinement theorem is claimed.

source_binding.scope: Current87 distributed files and selected FS bytes verified as provenance. The original scoped selector/control proofs retain their cuts and limits. Changed private numerical logic and production SHA are not proved; native91 includes four omitted vendor digests only.
